review.scope: Final maintainability, lifecycle, compatibility and research-ML evidence review

source_edits.scope: Local reversible v024 source, config, tests and documents

repository_discipline.rationale: The implementation keeps command, control, Reward, backend and configuration responsibilities at their owner boundaries.

dimensions.name: responsibility-ownership
dimensions.evidence: Command canonicalization, phase/control state, pure Reward kernels, sensor bindings and profile identity remain separate owners.

dimensions.name: public-interface
dimensions.evidence: The implementation consumes public net-contact sensors, cached public gains and actuator force limits without backend-private probes.

dimensions.name: dependency-direction
dimensions.evidence: Bindings depend on pure G1 owner modules; scripts and backend subclasses do not acquire Reward rules.

dimensions.name: state-lifecycle
dimensions.evidence: A one-use target marker admits only real physics-step Reward transactions; refresh only synchronizes external command transitions and observations.

dimensions.name: change-surface
dimensions.evidence: A separate disabled-by-default selector activates v024 while legacy paths remain selected independently.

dimensions.name: evidence-boundary
dimensions.evidence: Module/config tests and one bounded MuJoCo reset/step establish only their declared boundaries; full persistence, training and gait-quality claims remain explicitly open.

dimensions.name: proof-route
dimensions.evidence: Twenty-eight focused tests cover boundaries, transitions, disabled left-knee strength side effects, stale-target rejection, external refresh, tensor layout and fail-closed identity drift.

dimensions.name: tensor-provenance
dimensions.evidence: Command stays at actor indices 93:96, phase at 96:98, actor width 98 and FADA state/action/command widths 66/29/3.

dimensions.name: gradient-update-boundary
dimensions.evidence: No learner, optimizer, replay or update-frequency code changed in this v024 unit.

dimensions.name: persistence-evaluation
dimensions.evidence: Schema 3 is unchanged; behavior profile and effective config hashes reject missing, stale or same-shape incompatible checkpoints.

residual_risks: A bounded MuJoCo reset/step smoke establishes initial live reachability but not the full update and persistence route.
No training establishes Reward learnability or policy quality.
The source and v024 selectors exclude targeted actuator faults while retaining generic all-joint Kp/Kd and broad physical DR; targeted faults belong to downstream failed-rollout collection.
